title.narrative: 1.1 EVIDENCE-BASED, GENDER-RESPONSIVE EDUCATION & YOUTH REFORM POLICIES

description.narrative: Policymakers and key stakeholders have coordinated and developed evidence-based, gender-responsive education and youth-reform policies.
Palestine, State of
'Abasan al Kabira
Beit Lahiya
Khuza'a

sector.narrative: Provision of (formal and non-formal) multiple-levels or alternative pathways of education (including in temporary learning spaces)
Provision of skills development (including in temporary learning spaces)
Provision or procurement of primary education learning materials
System strengthening - Evidence based education sector planning
System strengthening - early learning / pre-primary teaching and learning environment (including curriculum and material design)
System strengthening - inclusive education for other vulnerable children poorest quintile, ethnic/linguistic minorities, migrant children, non-citizens/undocumented children etc.
System strengthening - mainstreaming of skills development within national education/training system
System strengthening - risk informed programming, including climate, resilience, disaster, conflict, and emergency preparedness
Technical assistance - Equitable access to quality education
